name: Attaches Policy
description: An IAM role or user has a customer-managed IAM policy attached (principal -> policy): iam:AttachRolePolicy / iam:AttachUserPolicy, as ListAttachedRolePolicies / ListAttachedUserPolicies report it. Emitted only for customer-managed policies, whose nodes the collector holds; the full list, AWS-managed policies included, is the principal's attached_policy_arns field, which is what an AWS-managed policy (identical in every account, never a node of this account) needs. Inline policies are not attachments and are not modelled here.
